summary: Set device_type to a value from the normalized taxonomy, and optionally add a platform field such as aws, vmware or azure.
questions: How do I indicate the cloud provider in a resource query?

answer_card.title: Setting device_type and platform
answer_card.answer_md: Set `device_type` to a standard taxonomy value. Optionally add `platform` (e.g. `aws`, `vmware`, `azure`).
